inputs.value:
`---
- name: Download KB files only for this host
  hosts: windows
  gather_facts: no

  vars:
    kb_files_json: '${JSON.stringify($kb_download_url_filename_map)}'
    host_kb_map_json: '${JSON.stringify($host_kb_and_sys_info_map)}'
    destinationFolder: '${$folder_path_to_download_kbs}'

  tasks:

    - name: Ensure destinationFolder ends with backslash
      set_fact:
        normalized_destinationFolder: "{{ destinationFolder | regex_replace('\\\\+$', '') + '\\\\' }}"

    - name: Parse KB files JSON
      set_fact:
        kb_files_list: "{{ kb_files_json | from_json }}"

    - name: Parse host KB map JSON
      set_fact:
        host_kb_map: "{{ host_kb_map_json | from_json }}"

    - name: Normalize host KB list
      set_fact:
        host_kbs_normalized: "{{ host_kb_map[inventory_hostname].kbList | default([]) }}"

    - name: Build patterns for this host
      set_fact:
        kb_patterns: >-
          [
            '{{ host_kb_map[inventory_hostname].systemInfo.productName | regex_escape }}'
            ~ '.*'
            ~ '{{ host_kb_map[inventory_hostname].systemInfo.displayVersion | default('') | regex_escape }}'
            ~ '.*'
            ~ '{{ host_kb_map[inventory_hostname].systemInfo.architecture | regex_escape }}'
            ~ '.*'
            ~ '{{ host_kbs_normalized | map("regex_escape") | join("|") }}',
            '{{ host_kbs_normalized | map("regex_escape") | join("|") }}'
          ]

    - name: Filter KBs using prioritized patterns
      set_fact:
        filtered_kb_files: >-
          {{
            kb_files_list
            | selectattr('kbNumber', 'in', host_kbs_normalized)
            | selectattr('fileName', 'search', '(' + kb_patterns | join('|') + ')')
            | list
          }}

    - name: Debug filtered list
      debug:
        msg: "{{ filtered_kb_files }}"

    - name: Ensure destinationFolder exists
      ansible.windows.win_file:
        path: "{{ normalized_destinationFolder }}"
        state: directory

    - name: Download KB files into user-defined folder
      ansible.windows.win_shell: |
        $url = "{{ item.url }}"
        $fileName = "{{ item.fileName }}"
        $destinationPath = Join-Path -Path "{{ normalized_destinationFolder }}" -ChildPath $fileName

        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $destinationPath -UseBasicParsing
        Write-Output "Downloaded to $destinationPath"
      loop: "{{ filtered_kb_files }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.kbNumber }}"
`

meta.description: This workflow automates the download of Windows update files (.msu or .cab) based on a list of input CVEs or KB numbers.
